summary: Fiat/crypto display + refresh audit E2E verification. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass against the live preview (display-currency fx meta, fx block + currency_symbol consistency on dashboard/overview/payouts/brands/invoices/period-summary/dashboard-root/wallet getWallet, chart 200, fee-tiers tolerated, tax collected-report has summary.unconverted_currencies, no NaN anywhere, SSE /api/events/stream sends `event: connected`). Frontend (Playwright + route mocks on PROD Next build): stale EUR fallback shows €amount + 'Rate as of hh:mm' on /wallet and /transactions; NGN->USD fallback shows $amount + 'Shown in USD · NGN rate unavailable' and never mixes ₦ with $; live (unmocked) renders no label on /wallet, /dashboard, /payouts, /brands, /invoices (clean-session verified). dashboard-fx-as-of / payouts-fx-as-of / brands-fx-as-of / invoices-fx-as-of all render when fx.is_stale=true is injected via route.fetch+patch. 60s auto-refresh re-requests /api/user/display-currency (+1) and /api/dashboard/overview (+2 incl. SSE) within 70s with no skeleton flash. SSE money_update event triggers extra /api/dashboard/overview and /api/dashboard requests within ~3s. Currency change via settings PATCH mock works and toast shows 'Brand currency updated' but display-currency refetch after PATCH was NOT observed in a 4s window (needs confirmation). KYC flash: with 3s delay on /api/kyc/status, kyc-requirements never rendered during load (0 samples at 200ms cadence) while kyc-requirements-loading skeleton was visible; verified state after resolve correctly keeps requirements hidden. No horizontal overflow at 1920x800 or 390x844 across dashboard/wallet/transactions/payouts/brands/invoices.

integration_issues.issue: After the PATCH /api/company/display-currency/1 completes (toast 'Brand currency updated' shown), /api/user/display-currency was NOT re-requested within the 4s observation window. Spec requires immediate re-fetch of display-currency and other amount endpoints. May be a counter/timing miss OR a missing dispatch of requestFiatRefresh / FIAT_REFRESH_EVENT in DisplayCurrencySelector's onSuccess path. Please verify in Components/UI/DisplayCurrencySelector/index.tsx.

wallet_fallback_ngn_to_usd.label: Shown in USD · NGN rate unavailable

notes_on_console_errors: During the regression sweep several pages logged console errors (4-79 counts). The dashboard/wallet/transactions pages at desktop width logged 0. Investigation showed a toast 'Request failed with status code 429' present on multiple pages — this is Dynopay backend rate-limiting triggered by the testing script running back-to-back scenarios; not caused by the audit changes. On a fresh session (TEST 9 rerun) no label-render regressions were seen. Flagging for awareness only.
critical_code_review_comments: DisplayCurrencySelector onSuccess should explicitly call requestFiatRefresh() (or dispatch FIAT_REFRESH_EVENT) so that /api/user/display-currency and all amount-bearing endpoints are re-fetched immediately after the merchant changes brand currency. Current observation: PATCH 200 + toast fired, but no refetch of /api/user/display-currency in the 4s window. Verify in Components/UI/DisplayCurrencySelector/index.tsx around the mutation success handler.
Preview backend is rate-limited on the merchant JWT; test tooling should throttle (reasonable in prod) — no code change required but QA should rate-pace.
action_items: Confirm/implement immediate re-fetch of /api/user/display-currency and amount endpoints on brand-currency PATCH success (DisplayCurrencySelector onSuccess -> requestFiatRefresh).

Pytest file lives at /app/tests/test_fiat_crypto_audit.py and runs in <20s.
